theorems.name: EthLib.Networking.Quic.Tls.Handshake.ClientTrace.certificate_verify
EthLib.Networking.Quic.Tls.Handshake.ServerTrace.certificate_verify
theorems.statement:
theorem ServerTrace.certificate_verify {config : Config} {observations : List Observation}
    {state : State} (trace : ServerTrace config observations state)
    (phase : state.phase = .clientFinished) :
    ServerCertificateObserved config observations state.peerChain

theorems.name: EthLib.Networking.Quic.Tls.Handshake.ClientCertificateObserved.signature
theorems.statement:
theorem ClientCertificateObserved.signature {config : Config} {expected : ByteArray}
    {observations : List Observation} {chain : List ByteArray}
    (observed : ClientCertificateObserved config expected observations chain) :
    ∃ observation ∈ observations, ∃ algorithm signature peer,
      observation.before.peerChain = chain ∧
      readMessage .handshake observation.input =
        .ok (.certificateVerify algorithm signature) ∧
      algorithm ∈ config.policy.signatureSchemes ∧ algorithm.val = 0x0403 ∧
      authenticate config (some expected) chain = .ok peer ∧
      Libp2p.Tls.verifyP256 peer.certificate.spki
        (certificateVerifyInput true observation.before.transcript.hash) signature = true

theorems.name: EthLib.Networking.Quic.Tls.Handshake.ServerCertificateObserved.signature
theorems.statement:
theorem ServerCertificateObserved.signature {config : Config} {observations : List Observation}
    {chain : List ByteArray}
    (observed : ServerCertificateObserved config observations chain) :
    ∃ observation ∈ observations, ∃ algorithm signature peer,
      observation.before.peerChain = chain ∧
      readMessage .handshake observation.input =
        .ok (.certificateVerify algorithm signature) ∧
      algorithm ∈ config.policy.signatureSchemes ∧ algorithm.val = 0x0403 ∧
      authenticate config none chain = .ok peer ∧
      Libp2p.Tls.verifyP256 peer.certificate.spki
        (certificateVerifyInput false observation.before.transcript.hash) signature = true

theorems.name: EthLib.Networking.Quic.Tls.Handshake.ClientTrace.completion_authenticated
theorems.statement:
theorem ClientTrace.completion_authenticated {config : Config} {expected : ByteArray}
    {observations : List Observation} {state : State} {input : FlightMessage} {step : Step}
    {result : Completion} (trace : ClientTrace config expected observations state)
    (accepted : clientStep config expected state input = .ok step)
    (completed : step.completion = some result) :
    ClientCertificateObserved config expected observations result.peerChain ∧
      ∃ value, readMessage .handshake input = .ok (.finished value) ∧
        checkFinished true state value = .ok ()

theorems.name: EthLib.Networking.Quic.Tls.Handshake.ServerTrace.completion_authenticated
theorems.statement:
theorem ServerTrace.completion_authenticated {config : Config}
    {observations : List Observation} {state : State} {input : FlightMessage} {step : Step}
    {result : Completion} (trace : ServerTrace config observations state)
    (accepted : serverStep config state input = .ok step)
    (completed : step.completion = some result) :
    ServerCertificateObserved config observations result.peerChain ∧
      ∃ value, readMessage .handshake input = .ok (.finished value) ∧
        checkFinished false state value = .ok ()

theorems.name: EthLib.Networking.Quic.Tls.Handshake.ClientTrace.no_completion_without_certificateVerify
EthLib.Networking.Quic.Tls.Handshake.ServerTrace.no_completion_without_certificateVerify
theorems.statement:
theorem ServerTrace.no_completion_without_certificateVerify {config : Config}
    {observations : List Observation} {state : State} {input : FlightMessage}
    {step : Step} {result : Completion} (trace : ServerTrace config observations state)
    (absent : ∀ observation ∈ observations, ∀ algorithm signature,
      readMessage .handshake observation.input ≠
        .ok (.certificateVerify algorithm signature))
    (completed : step.completion = some result) : serverStep config state input ≠ .ok step

theorems.name: EthLib.Networking.Quic.Tls.Handshake.clientStep_finished_before_certificateVerify
theorems.statement:
theorem clientStep_finished_before_certificateVerify (config : Config) (expected : ByteArray)
    (state : State) (input : FlightMessage) (value : ByteArray)
    (phase : state.phase = .serverCertificateVerify)
    (message : readMessage .handshake input = .ok (.finished value)) :
    clientStep config expected state input = .error .unexpectedMessage

theorems.name: EthLib.Networking.Quic.Tls.Handshake.serverStep_finished_before_certificateVerify
theorems.statement:
theorem serverStep_finished_before_certificateVerify (config : Config) (state : State)
    (input : FlightMessage) (value : ByteArray)
    (phase : state.phase = .clientCertificateVerify)
    (message : readMessage .handshake input = .ok (.finished value)) :
    serverStep config state input = .error .unexpectedMessage

scope: ClientTrace and ServerTrace begin with successful actual clientStart/serverStart results and retain every actual successful step before/input/result.
One immutable Config throughout each trace, and one original expected peer ID throughout each client trace.
Every completion has a CertificateVerify observation in its earlier initialized trace for the same exact peer-chain bytes that completion returns.
The signature observation uses an offered and permitted P-256/SHA-256 scheme and the exact role-specific signed transcript; signature projection exposes the permitted scheme and authenticated peer.
The completing invocation checks the peer Finished against its actual pre-message transcript and saved handshake traffic secret.
No completion exists with no prior CertificateVerify message in that initialized trace; Finished in the CertificateVerify phase is universally rejected.
limits: Finite accepted-call histories, with caller-supplied complete reassembled messages.

No claim of handshake unforgeability, cryptographic hardness, nonce pseudorandomness, fresh or secret ephemeral keys, constant-time execution, transport/reassembly authenticity, physical I/O or lifecycle enforcement after a rejected call.
The client/server agreement theorem for independent key shares and transcript delivery is not added.
The traces reset on each initialization; no previous trace authorizes a restarted one.
